$comment: The official plugins (the ones DeckPilot bundles) built here, and the permission policy each must keep (official/README.md). `plugins` are released (signed, one GitHub Release per version); `fixtures` are built, packaged, signed with throwaway keys and compared with DeckPilot's build in CI only, never released. `permissions` is the exact set of permission kinds a plugin's manifest may declare: anything else, and every plugin API 1.9 privileged kind while the gate is closed, fails tools/check-official.py, unless the plugin is `held` (the reason, as text): then its source is on main, built, tested and compared, and its package, signatures, release and Marketplace entry are refused.

plugins.held: needs plugin API 1.14 (connections: the `connections` permission, `connection` parameters, `openUrl.connections`), which no DeckPilot has yet: its contracts (knittingcode/deckpilot#451), host side and bundling come first, then its security review and release

0.2.0 needs plugin API 1.12 (the typed repository variables: `host:project.repositories`, `host:project.repository`, knittingcode/deckpilot#460), which no published DeckPilot provides yet: P8 (plugin API in the agent, the privileged policy entry of 0.2.0 in both repositories) and a published DeckPilot providing 1.12 come first, then its release (P9). While it is held, no 0.1.x patch is released from main

needs plugin API 1.13 (the `scripts` permission, the `script` parameter kind, the `scripts` view), which no DeckPilot has yet: its host bridge (P6) and bundling (P8) come first, then its security review and release (P9). Release blocker: the vendored wasi-libc libc.a and QuickJS-NG sources of rquickjs-sys 0.14.0 must be recorded as reviewed code first (scripts/README.md)
